item.title: Heart of the Forest Community Special School partially closed on Thursday, 26 November 2026
item.description: Otters Class is closed to all pupils on Thursday 26th November 2026. Otters class will re-open as usual on Friday 27th November 2026. All other classes remain open on Thursday 26th November 2026.
